description: Main entry point for a Probot application handling repository initialization, issue events, and comment management, integrating with external services via axios and managing repository data and communication with a Flask backend.

methods.name: getInitializationComment
methods.description: Generates a welcome message for repository initialization.

methods.name: getRunningComment
methods.description: Generates a setup in progress message.

methods.name: getCompletionComment
methods.description: Generates a completion message indicating setup is finished.

methods.name: replyWithError
methods.description: Sends an error reply comment on an issue.
